'''Patriotic soup''' ({{zh|s=[[wikt:护国菜|护国菜]]|t=[[wikt:護國菜|護國菜]]|p=hùguó cài|l=protect the country dish}}, [[Teochew language|Teochew]]: ''hu gog chai'') is a [[vegetable soup]] originated by [[Teochew people]]. It was developed during the final year of China's [[Song dynasty]] as an improvisational dish.
